d:
Seoul is one of the biggest, brightest, and busiest cities on the planet, but did you know that hundreds of thousands of its residents are living in micro-apartments that can barely fit a small bed? Join me in this adventure as I take you around Seoul to meet residents living in these tiny homes and find out their stories!
Huge thanks to my friend Jimmy for taking me around Seoul! Check out his channel here:
I wrote a book called JUST GO, with exclusive travel stories & tips to inspire your next adventures!
